name: traceguard
description: Graph-powered AI investigation assistant for fraud analysts: graph tools compute, Gemini on Vertex AI explains with validated citations, the analyst judges. Synthetic data.

paragraphs: TraceGuard is a graph-powered AI investigation assistant for fraud analysts at banks, e-wallets and fintechs. It traces fund movements across accounts, devices and time, then uses Gemini on Vertex AI to write a case brief in which every claim is cited to a real record. Every brief is validated before an analyst sees it.
Built for the AI Builder Cup 2026 (Google Cloud × Hack2skill), BFSI theme, by Team Chilli. All data is synthetic.

A single alert rarely tells the whole story. The risk sits between the records: who paid whom, in what order, and which accounts share a device. Analysts must reconstruct that by hand, then explain it in a case file. A generic AI summary is not good enough here: it can invent a transaction, state a wrong total, or call someone a fraudster.
